text: {"reply":"I'm sorry you're stuck. Please stay safe. If you can, get your car as far onto the shoulder as possible and keep your hazard lights on. Stay out of the car and away from traffic if you can do that safely. If you or anyone else is in danger or hurt, call 911 now.\n\nI have your spot as the QEW heading toward Burlington, just past the mall exit. I'm passing this to a person now so they can arrange help. One correction: I haven't dispatched a tow or found your record yet. A person will review your request and take it from here.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"safety","summary":"Customer reports a stalled 2020 Meridian Tessera on the QEW, heading toward Burlington, just past the mall exit. The reply corrected this. Urgent roadside help is needed. A person should confirm the customer's safety and arrange the tow.","policy_rules_cited":["P07","P14","P02","P13"]}
